name: dedup
note: The four-paragraph window (current_pos in range(4), core.py:259) and everything it drops: an H3 repeating the title, an IMG repeating previewImage, an H4 equal to a tag, plus the truncated-subtitle rule that only *clears* the subtitle without dropping the paragraph. Paragraph five is the same H3 as paragraph two and is rendered, because the window has closed — that is the point of this fixture.

previewContent.subtitle: A long subtitle that was truncated…

paragraphs.text: This first paragraph is deliberately longer than one hundred characters so that the truncated-subtitle rule fires and clears the subtitle before anything else in the article renders at all.
paragraphs.name: d1
